newsitem.title: CHINA: China aims to collect 10 pct more taxes in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China aims to collect 10 pct more taxes in 1997.

text.p: China aims to collect 10.3 percent more industrial and commercial taxes in 1997 than in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
China had set a target of collecting 695.13 billion yuan ($83.8 billion) in taxes in 1997, Xinhua quoted Xiang Huaicheng, deputy-director of the State Administration of Taxation, as saying.

Value-added and consumer taxes were expected to grow 12 percent to 409.3 billion yuan in 1997, Xiang said. The administration planned to introduce inheritance tax, real estate tax, land-use tax and urban construction tax, he said.
